from fmtcsv import read_csv, summarize, format_summary
import tempfile, os

# 1) Leading/trailing spaces inside quotes still preserved
content = 'a,b\n\"  keep spaces  \",end\n'
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', suffix='.csv', delete=False) as f:
    f.write(content); p = f.name
s = summarize(read_csv(p))
assert s['first_data_row'] == ['  keep spaces  ', 'end'], s['first_data_row']
print('spaces preserved:', repr(s['first_data_row']))

# 2) Summary print format unchanged
out = format_summary(s)
expected = 'Total rows: 1\nTotal columns: 2\nFirst data row:   keep spaces  , end'
assert out == expected, out
print('format unchanged:', repr(out))
os.unlink(p)
"", "title": "Verify whitespace handling and summary format unchanged"}
